description: This Java source file defines the class 'EcuDefinitionInheritanceList', which provides static methods for retrieving a list of inheritance nodes from an ECU definition XML DOM document, based on ECU definitions and CAL IDs, utilizing XPath expressions.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionInheritanceList
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to retrieve ECU inheritance nodes from an XML DOM document based on ECU definitions and CAL IDs.

methods.name: getInheritanceList
methods.description: Returns a list of XML Nodes representing the inheritance hierarchy based on the ECU definition and the XML DOM document, traversing parent definitions until the 'BASE' is reached.

methods.name: getBaseRomId
methods.description: Retrieves the CAL ID of the base ROM from the document given a specific CAL ID, using XPath query.

methods.name: getBaseRomIdNode
methods.description: Retrieves the Node corresponding to the 'rom' element that contains the specified CAL ID.
